sp_widget.name: HOC - Task number reader

sys_package.display_value: RBH Occupational Health and Safety Management

sys_scope.display_value: RBH Occupational Health and Safety Management

sp_widget.template:
<script>

  //var rawContent = document.getElementsByClassName("status")[0].innerHTML;
  //var taskNumber = rawContent.match(/HRT[0-9]{7}/)
  
  //Explanation
  /*
  *  Since we could not find a solution for the Record Producer to know which task has opened it, we used another trick.
  *  In the todo list, there is a division with the class "task-content" that contains the task details (It's the second element with that class, which explains the position [1].
  *  In that div's id, we can extract the task task sys_id (There are the 32 first caracters of of the id name)
  *  It will work as long as the page HTML structure do not change in an incompatible way (For instance, having more element with the class 'task-content' before the one we use)
  *  In the end, this variable (taskNumber) will be used in the onLoad script to get the sys_id of the case.
  */
  var taskNumber = document.getElementsByClassName("task-content")[1].id.substring(0,32); //take first 32 caracters
  
</script>
